_note: Sources the user opens to find a real price himself. We never state a price. Every link is a plain URL: no affiliate, no tracking. An item with no entry in 'items' gets no guide button. linksLastChecked stays null until a person has opened every link in a real browser and written the date here; scripts/check-links.ts only helps with that.
